claims.quote: Type locality: Rio Uruguay at "Rancho da Amizade," São Borja, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.

regions.name: La Plata
regions.quote: Also recorded in the La Plata basin: Uruguay, Paraná (including Middle Paraná and Bermejo), Paraguay (including Pilcomayo, Upper Pilcomayo, and Upper Paraguay with the Cuiabá and Manso rivers).
